task.summary: Calendar agenda view and responsive unscheduled tasks sidebar lifecycle

decision.selected: Responsive MobileAgenda presentation with decoupled unscheduled tasks modal
decision.rejected: Dense multi-day grid forced onto phone viewports or always-open mobile sidebar
decision.reason: Vertical day grouping fits narrow screens and separating sidebar state prevents surprise modals on resize
decision.preserved: Desktop multi-day grid, schedule block CRUD operations, and user timezone conversion

limitations: Touch drag-and-drop between days on touchscreens not tested in headless environment
Physical mobile browser rotation animations not verified
Tested on simulated desktop and mobile viewports with automated regression suite

checks.assertion: Baseline calendar displayed time grid on desktop viewports
checks.observed: Day and week grid views rendered with scheduling slots on desktop

checks.assertion: Baseline lacked narrow-width agenda list presentation for mobile viewports
checks.observed: Desktop grid was clipped and required horizontal scrolling on phone screens

checks.assertion: Calendar renders MobileAgenda day grouped list when on mobile viewports
checks.observed: Agenda cards display timezone-aware events with schedule detail modal transition

checks.assertion: Unscheduled tasks modal opens on explicit toggle with dialog role and focus trap
checks.observed: Modal opens with body scroll lock and closes on close button or Escape key

checks.assertion: Resizing from desktop to mobile does not automatically pop up unscheduled modal
checks.observed: Desktop sidebar state separated from mobile panel preventing unintended modal opening

checks.assertion: Cross-day touch drag-and-drop rescheduling on physical mobile device
checks.observed: Physical device touch gestures excluded from automated test suite
